name: litetms
description: Ask about your transport company's drivers and employees in LiteTMS: find a person, see how to reach them, check which documents expire and which vehicle they use. Read-only for now. You sign in with your own LiteTMS account.

interface.longDescription:
LiteTMS is a transport management system (TMS) that road carriers and freight forwarders use to run their fleet, drivers, contractors and transport orders. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your company's LiteTMS workspace, so you can ask about your drivers in plain language instead of opening the Employees tab.

What you can do today:
- Find a driver or another employee by name, status or position.
- See who is active, who no longer works for the company and who is archived.
- Get a person's phone numbers and e-mail addresses.
- Check their documents and expiry dates, with a status for each one: valid, expiring, expired or unknown.
- See the vehicle and trailer a driver currently uses, their languages, ADR qualification and branches.
- Open the record in LiteTMS through a direct link.

How access works: you sign in with your own LiteTMS account. The plugin then sees exactly what you are allowed to see in LiteTMS. Your role and your branches apply to every answer, so two colleagues can get different results for the same question.

Who it is for: dispatchers, forwarders, fleet managers and office staff of companies that already use LiteTMS.

Limits: for now the connection is read-only, so it cannot add, change or delete anything. It covers drivers and employees only. Orders, vehicles, GPS positions and other areas are not available yet; more tools, including ones that make changes, are added step by step. It never returns home addresses, dates of birth, bank details, salary, document numbers or attached files.

Before you start: you need a LiteTMS account, and an administrator of your company has to turn on the "ChatGPT, Claude & MCP" module in LiteTMS under Administration > Marketplace. When you connect, enter your company's LiteTMS address (for example acme for acme.litetms.eu), sign in and choose Allow. You can disconnect at any time in LiteTMS under Settings > Connected apps.
